He originally underwent a catheter ablation procedure several years ago to manage his arrhythmia. He reports that he has had no recurrence since the procedure and feels well. He denies any palpitations, shortness of breath, dizziness, or syncope. Because he has remained stable and asymptomatic, he is not currently taking any medication for rate or rhythm control. He also confirms that he does not require any medication for his heart condition at this time.

Multivitamin daily.
Lisinopril 10mg daily.

HR: 74 bpm (regular)

TSH: 2.1 mIU/L
